How To Install eFootball PES 2025 PPSSPP – PSP Iso Save Data Textures 

Follow steps carefully below on how to install PES 2025 Iso file, Textures files and Save Data files. 

Steps to Install eFootball PES 2025 PPSSPP – PSP are: 

  1. Using installed Zarchiver App locate downloaded PES 2025 PPSSPP – PSP Iso Save Data Textures in zip or rar format.
  2. Click on it, a options menu will come up and then “Click Extract”.
  3. Then immediately click on the name of the folder where you keep the downloaded eFootball PES file, at the top of Zarchiver app interface.
  4. From the drop down menu that appears, click Device Storage and wait.
  5. Finally click “Extract Icon” like in the image below.
  6. Then wait till eFootball PES 2025 PPSSPP – PSP Iso and other files is completely extracted and in the process a PSP folder will be created or it will overwrite already available PSP folder.
  7. Next you install PPSSPP Emulator App just as you see in the image below.
  8. Open PPSSPP Emulator app and Click ok just like in the image below and continue.
  9. Then scroll down and locate PSP Folder like in the image below, then click on it.
  10. Now click the button Use This Folder and proceed to the next step.
  11. Give permissions by clicking allow.
  12. Finally change ppsspp emulator Language to Espanol, this will help fix black screen and launch the game.

How To Fix PES 2025 eFootball PPSSPP Game Crashed 

If the game displays blue screen just like in the image below, showing “Game Crashed”, follow steps below on how to fix it below.

Steps to fix game crashed in PES 2025 PPSSPP are:

  1. Go to settings tab in PPSSPP Emulator.
  2. Click on System tab and proceed.
  3. Scroll down and look for Fast Memory, untick or disable it.
  4. Also untick or disable Ignore bad memory accesses.

How To Fix No Sound Or Commentary In PES PPSSPP Emulator 

Latest update of PPSSPP – PSP emulator starting from version 1.19 doesn’t allow you to hear sound in PES eFootball 2025 PSP, below is how you can fix the error to hear background sounds, music and commentary in the game. 

Steps to fix no sound in PES 2025 are: 

  1. Enter PPSSPP emulator for Android and click settings like in the image below.
  2. Click Tools tab and continue.
  3. Then click Developer tools.
  4. Click Disable HLE tab.
  5. Finally Tick “Use the old sceAtrac implementation”. You will see that the game sound and commentary is working as normal.
